explication: ViewInspector is a Swift library for unit-testing SwiftUI views by reflecting on their runtime structure. A test starts inspection on a view, then traverses or searches the resulting hierarchy, reads view and modifier state, and can invoke supported callbacks to simulate interactions. The graph highlights the shared reflection and hierarchy machinery plus representative view, modifier, and popup inspection. README capabilities guide the coverage; several subsystem details are inferred from the file tree because their source was not sampled.
